vacancies.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (conversational UI)

verdict.text: The vacancy is UK-located and says nothing about work authorization. If it can't be done from outside the UK, stop here.

would_change: Written confirmation that the role can be done remotely from the candidate's country, as a contractor.

requirements.requirement: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
requirements.evidence: Frontend engineer, 6 years, mostly Angular and TypeScript

requirements.requirement: Deep proficiency in TypeScript and React or Angular
requirements.evidence: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, AG Grid, Jasmine, Karma, Git

requirements.requirement: Experience building real-time, asynchronous, event-driven user experiences

requirements.evidence: Reviewed code and mentored two junior developers

requirements.note: Did you lead any initiative end to end?

cv_fixes.text: Put the real-time WebSocket line first in the Acme Analytics bullets. It is the closest match to the core of this vacancy.
If you led a migration or a design decision, say so with its scope and your role.

new.text: Architecture influence, standards and mentoring: a step up from the CV's scope
Streaming and typing states in a conversational UI are a new problem on familiar tools

red_flags.text: UK location; the vacancy is silent on work authorization.

red_flags.quote: Fast-paced environment, we promote from within
red_flags.text: Culture words with no process described.

vacancies.money: Not stated. Contract type for a non-UK contractor is not stated either.

questions.question: Can this be done from outside the UK, and as what: employee or contractor?
questions.why: Decides if it is possible at all.

questions.question: Is 8+ years a hard requirement or a guide?
Who owns frontend architecture decisions today?
questions.why: What would be mine to decide.

questions.question: What is the salary range, gross or net?

talking_points.vacancy: Experience building real-time, asynchronous, event-driven user experiences

talking_points.point: Mention mentoring as it was: two juniors, through review.
talking_points.cv: Reviewed code and mentored two junior developers

talking_points.point: Say the gap plainly: six years against 8+, and point to the scope instead.
